# The Toddler Program

> Small, non-profit preschool in Kaimukī, Honolulu, Hawaiʻi, for children ages 2–5.

## Facts (updated 2026-10-20)
- Name: The Toddler Program
- Address: 3509 Pāhoa Ave, Honolulu, HI 96816 (Kaimukī)
- Phone: (808) 735-3197
- Email: admin@thetoddlerprogram.com
- School day: Mon–Fri 8:15 am–2:30 pm; drop-off from 7:00 am; optional after-school care until the end of the day (additional fee)
- Office hours: Mon–Fri 8:15 am–3:00 pm [to confirm with Becky]
- Ages: 2–5 in four classes: Sunshine Bears (age 2); Aloha Bears (age 3); Friendship Bears (age 4); Honey Bears · Jr. K (age 5)
- Two-year-olds are welcome even if not yet potty trained
- Curriculum: literature-based; Monday enrichment in Music, Mandarin and movement; walking excursions in Kaimukī
- Non-profit with Christian values; families of all faiths welcome
- Tuition: contact the office for current 2026–27 tuition
- Tours: about 30 minutes; call or email to book. Apply through the office after touring.
- Social: https://www.facebook.com/thetoddlerprogram/ · https://www.instagram.com/thetoddlerprogram
